# Controlled recovery argv interface
This task accepts an argument array, not a shell command or every Maven CLI feature. Goals: clean, validate, compile, test, package, verify, install. Only an actually complete source/dependency/JAR result passes; compile alone is insufficient. Full-reactor package/verify are lawful without installing.
Selectors: -pl/--projects and -rf/--resume-from, using a separate value; long --projects=value and --resume-from=value also work. Values name lib/api/web, ./lib/./api/./web, :lib/:api/:web/:reactor, exact org.opsforge.session04:artifact IDs, root ., or comma lists of those known selectors. Do not assume resume reconstructs excluded upstream projects.
Make/safe switches: -am/--also-make, -amd/--also-make-dependents, -B/--batch-mode, -ntp/--no-transfer-progress, -o/--offline, -ff/--fail-fast, -fae/--fail-at-end. -f/--file accepts only pom.xml, ./pom.xml, or the known module's relative pom.xml; --file=value is supported. Attached-short-value variants and unrelated CLI options are outside this controlled interface.
No arbitrary -D, skip-tests, repository override, deploy/plugin goals, unknown groups/modules, external POM, directory escape, quiet output that removes required evidence, or fail-never. The trusted harness owns test/failure and repository flags. Source manifests, actual compiler classpaths, packaged Java behavior, dependency/JAR hashes and complete downstream graph are checked in real Maven, not inferred from argument labels.

body:
## 操作环境
固定Maven3.8.7、Ubuntu OpenJDK21和已封存插件。仅UID1000私有Java/JUnit reactor及仓库；不授权生产或外部流水线、服务部署、系统安装、默认PATH/身份变化。
## 给定材料
原生lib→api→web，api测试失败，上一作业只package；实际条件涵盖空仓库、旧缓存、失败后前置源码改变。保留原始输入、原始生命周期与真实依赖/下游摘要，不能用教学日志替代Maven。
## 操作任务
完成recovery.json的Maven args数组，在三个完整原生情景内恢复构建；说明-rf与-pl/-am实际reactor选择、package/install和同工作区/干净仓库差异。不得手拷JAR、跳过测试或冒称发布。
## 产物
- recovery.json
- decision.md：证据、负责人、判断、不同错解、合法替代、停止条件、固定版本边界。
- verification.md：检查、原命令证据、清理及回退。
## 验收方法
真实Maven消费交付参数；完整三情景验证Java输出、输入SHA、实际compiler classpath和打包JAR运行一致并记录lib/api/web真实摘要；install另核私有仓库class/POM绑定，完整reactor package/verify不强制install。参考/合法替代通过，未完成/错误/投机/不同错解拒绝；说明由非作者按语义复核，不能以关键词取代。120秒合同，不缩减验证。

受控参数语法见recovery-arguments.md：支持已知模块裸名/相对路径/:artifact/精确group:artifact、逗号列表、短/长选择及make/resume别名与long=value；禁止跳测、改仓库、部署、目录逃逸等。不声称支持无关Maven CLI。

# Completed recovery decision
Build owner preserves original POM/source SHA256, failed command, versions and JUnit report; release owner blocks promotion until current dependencies and outputs are bound. This is native Java/Maven, not an external pipeline or production release.
Fixed Maven3.8.7/OpenJDK21 with release8: reactor root -> lib -> api -> web. api JUnit genuinely fails with failApi=true. package leaves lib/target JAR but does not install it. Existing workspace classes and old repository artifacts can hide this omission.
Chosen recovery: -pl :web -am clean install from root. It selects web and required upstream/root, clears selected outputs, retests/builds and installs into the task-private repository. Legal alternative: root clean install. Neither publishes remotely. -rf :api only truncates the reactor; it does not automatically reconstruct excluded lib. Do not generalize this exact-version observation to every version/flag combination.
Three real scenarios: empty teaching repository; old same-coordinate lib cache; upstream source changed again after failure. Each retains failure/current source manifests, executes failed package, same-workspace -rf package, forced-recompile -rf clean package, then the submitted recovery. A zero exit using stale dependencies is rejected. The actual packaged JAR runtime must print the current source marker; every packaged class must match its rebuilt class. Actual compiler debug classpaths identify the rebuilt reactor lib consumed, with its JAR/class SHA256, plus api/web JAR digests. Install also binds repository Lib.class and embedded POM to rebuilt current source, recording both JAR digests. Complete reactor package/verify does not require install: an unused old local cache is not evidence that it was consumed. Source changes require a new full-build acknowledgement, not a claim that old and new inputs are one commit.
Reject missing-upstream -rf, false claims that package performed install, compile-only recovery without JARs, skipped tests, copied JARs and text-only success. Stop on missing provenance, changed tool hashes, failed native commands or marker/digest mismatch. Discard only owned work/repository, retain evidence and rebuild the complete controlled graph; no release is authorized.

# Verification and rollback
checks/native-maven-result.json records real commands, exit/stdout/stderr, reactor sets, source manifests, dependency and downstream digests and actual Java results for all three scenarios. This document is not prebuilt successful output. Reference and root-rebuild alternative must pass; starter/noop, missing-upstream -rf, compile-only without JARs, web-only, fake text and early-exit must fail. Full-reactor clean package and clean verify, bare/colon/group selectors and supported short/long aliases are lawful when the real dependency and packaged-output binding passes. Platform import/public-fields/pending-execution/seed/idempotence are separately reviewed.
The trusted plugin download cache is sealed by source/hash; each scenario clones it, removes teaching org.opsforge entries, and actually rebuilds its dependencies. Tool cache is not a substitute for an empty teaching repository. No network is used for the reactor matrix. Temporary roots and repositories are removed in finally; tool root remains read-only. No system installation/service/image/deployment/Git write/default identity or PATH change. Rollback means discarding this isolated candidate; old sources remain intact.

# Completed recovery decision
Build owner preserves original POM/source SHA256, failed command, versions and JUnit report; release owner blocks promotion until current dependencies and outputs are bound. This is native Java/Maven, not an external pipeline or production release.
Fixed Maven3.8.7/OpenJDK21 with release8: reactor root -> lib -> api -> web. api JUnit genuinely fails with failApi=true. package leaves lib/target JAR but does not install it. Existing workspace classes and old repository artifacts can hide this omission.
Chosen recovery: -pl :web -am clean install from root. It selects web and required upstream/root, clears selected outputs, retests/builds and installs into the task-private repository. Legal alternative: root clean install. Neither publishes remotely. -rf :api only truncates the reactor; it does not automatically reconstruct excluded lib. Do not generalize this exact-version observation to every version/flag combination.
Three real scenarios: empty teaching repository; old same-coordinate lib cache; upstream source changed again after failure. Each retains failure/current source manifests, executes failed package, same-workspace -rf package, forced-recompile -rf clean package, then the submitted recovery. A zero exit using stale dependencies is rejected. The actual packaged JAR runtime must print the current source marker; every packaged class must match its rebuilt class. Actual compiler debug classpaths identify the rebuilt reactor lib consumed, with its JAR/class SHA256, plus api/web JAR digests. Install also binds repository Lib.class and embedded POM to rebuilt current source, recording both JAR digests. Complete reactor package/verify does not require install: an unused old local cache is not evidence that it was consumed. Source changes require a new full-build acknowledgement, not a claim that old and new inputs are one commit.
Reject missing-upstream -rf, false claims that package performed install, compile-only recovery without JARs, skipped tests, copied JARs and text-only success. Stop on missing provenance, changed tool hashes, failed native commands or marker/digest mismatch. Discard only owned work/repository, retain evidence and rebuild the complete controlled graph; no release is authorized.

For every row the local maven-metadata-opsforge-private-snapshot.xml, repository ID/URL, timestamped repository JAR path and exact SHA are linked to the locally consumed JAR. The report separately keeps CURRENT remote metadata: on the cached row that remote metadata already points to the newer snapshot and must not be presented as this job's old resolution. Native commands, real downstream JAR and class digests and Java output are retained. This fixture uses a compile-time constant so downstream class contents also show the consumed revision; equal source coordinates alone prove none of these facts.

Approval binds the first dependency SHA/content set and its original repository metadata. The original approved repository was sealed before the second deployment. Recovery restores that exact sealed repository into a separate owned file repository, uses a new consumer repository, and genuinely resolves/rebuilds the approved content. Its consumed dependency SHA and downstream class SHA match the approved row. JAR-container timestamps can differ between rebuilds, so JAR SHA equality is not invented as a general reproducible-build guarantee.

Stop mixed promotion immediately on mismatched/unknown dependency bytes, missing retained history or unbound approval. Rebuild every consumer of the changed dependency under the restored approved set; retain both failing and rebuilt evidence. Clearing caches cannot resurrect a historical snapshot already removed from a repository. Repository retention and approval records must exist BEFORE replacement. An additional valid option is an organization-approved immutable release/verified sealed-content mechanism, with real consumer resolution and binding checks; it is not enough to print SNAPSHOT coordinates. Discard only owned test directories; no production rollback is claimed.
